title: Energy field operations settlement bundle
description: Field-service completion and production evidence prepared for governed settlement.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: energy-field-operations-settlement
  title: Energy field operations settlement bundle
  description: Field-service completion and production evidence prepared for governed settlement.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-acct-01
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/energy
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [field_service_job.ticket_number, field_service_job.service_date, production_measurement.production_date, production_measurement.oil_volume_bbl]
      relationshipIds: [performed_at, measures]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/energy/field_ticket, role: completion }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/energy/production_report, role: supporting }
